lines.zh: 我沿着木屋的墙根绕一圈。
lines.en: I circle the walls of my wooden house.

lines.zh: 松针踩在靴底，声音很轻。
lines.en: Pine needles under my boots, barely a sound.

lines.zh: 我数着树，走到第七棵就回头。
lines.en: I count trees and turn back at the seventh.

lines.zh: 这条路走过太多次，闭眼也行。
lines.en: I have walked this path so often I could shut my eyes.

lines.zh: 弓背在肩上，撞着锁骨。
lines.en: My bow knocks against my collarbone as I walk.

lines.zh: 回旋镖挂在腰后，晃来晃去。
lines.en: The boomerang swings behind my hip.

lines.zh: 林子里有动静，我放慢脚步。
lines.en: Something moves in the trees; I slow my pace.

lines.zh: 我踩着落枝，故意让人听见。
lines.en: I step on fallen twigs, letting myself be heard.

lines.zh: 木屋的门轴有点响，我记住了。
lines.en: My cabin door hinge squeaks; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 巡视完这片林子，天就黑了。
lines.en: By the time I finish patrolling, night falls.

lines.zh: 我的靴子磨偏了，右脚更薄。
lines.en: My right boot is worn thinner than the left.

lines.zh: 再走两步，就能看见你。
lines.en: Two more steps and I will have you in sight.

lines.zh: 我擦着弩机，等一件事发生。
lines.en: I wipe the crossbow mechanism and wait for something.

lines.zh: 木屋角落堆着没用的箭杆。
lines.en: Useless arrow shafts pile in the cabin corner.

lines.zh: 林子太安静，我有点不安。
lines.en: The forest is too quiet, which unsettles me.

lines.zh: 我掰了块干粮，嚼得很慢。
lines.en: I break off some dried food and chew it slowly.

lines.zh: 回旋镖的刃口卷了，得磨。
lines.en: The boomerang's edge has rolled; it needs sharpening.

lines.zh: 我数着窗格的影子，数到十二。
lines.en: I count the shadows of the window slats to twelve.

lines.zh: 有只鸟在屋顶走，我没赶它。
lines.en: A bird walks on my roof; I let it stay.

lines.zh: 弓弦松了一点，我拧了两圈。
lines.en: The bowstring loosened, so I twisted it twice.

lines.zh: 我把笑声咽回去，时间还早。
lines.en: I swallow a laugh; it is still too early.

lines.zh: 木墙里有虫在啃，随它去。
lines.en: Something gnaws inside the wall; let it.

lines.zh: 你从哪条小径进来的？
lines.en: Which trail did you come in on?

lines.zh: 站那儿别动，让我看看你的弓。
lines.en: Stand still and let me look at your bow.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，走了一路。
lines.en: The smell of your iron has traveled a long way.

lines.zh: 我认得这双靴印，是新的。
lines.en: I know these bootprints; they are new.

lines.zh: 你先看我的，那我就先看你的。
lines.en: You looked at me first, so I look back.

lines.zh: 别假装是路过的。
lines.en: Do not pretend you were merely passing.

lines.zh: 你的手离武器太近了。
lines.en: Your hand is much too close to your weapon.

lines.zh: 这林子的主人，站着跟你说话。
lines.en: The master of this forest stands here talking.

lines.zh: 你的眼神扫过左边的岔路。
lines.en: Your gaze swept the fork on the left.

lines.zh: 我看着你，你就已经在射程里。
lines.en: While I watch you, you are already in range.

lines.zh: 这一箭挨得不轻。
lines.en: That arrow landed hard on me.

lines.zh: 我退到树后，先咽口东西。
lines.en: I retreat behind a tree and swallow something.

lines.zh: 嘴里的干粮救了我一次。
lines.en: The dried food in my mouth saved me once.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在肩甲缝里。
lines.en: The arrowhead is stuck in my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 你打得准，可惜不够深。
lines.en: You hit true, but not deep enough.

lines.zh: 我笑了，笑声里带着喘。
lines.en: I laugh, and the laugh carries a wheeze.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，弓还拉得开。
lines.en: It hurts, but I can still draw.

lines.zh: 血滴在松针上，很快渗下去。
lines.en: Blood drips onto pine needles and soaks away fast.

lines.zh: 我在数你还有几支箭。
lines.en: I am counting how many arrows you have left.

lines.zh: 等我吃完这口，就轮到你。
lines.en: Once I finish this bite, it is your turn.

lines.zh: 食物？我自己会打，不用喂。
lines.en: Food? I hunt my own; I need no feeding.

lines.zh: 你把面包举高，是当我看不见？
lines.en: Raise that bread higher; do you think I am blind?

lines.zh: 林子里的兔子比你的手快。
lines.en: The rabbits here are quicker than your hands.

lines.zh: 饿的时候我自己进食，不靠施舍。
lines.en: When hungry I feed myself, not on handouts.

lines.zh: 拿诱饵钓猎人，你很聪明。
lines.en: Baiting a hunter with food; how clever of you.

lines.zh: 这味道太熟，是陷阱的味道。
lines.en: That smell is familiar; it smells like a trap.

lines.zh: 放下，然后退开三十步。
lines.en: Put it down and back away thirty paces.

lines.zh: 你的手没洗，我不接。
lines.en: Your hands are unwashed; I will not take it.

lines.zh: 你要真有心，放只活鸡。
lines.en: If you mean it, leave a live chicken.

lines.zh: 我盯着的是你的手，不是食物。
lines.en: I am watching your hands, not the food.

lines.zh: 让开，我的箭袋不容挤。
lines.en: Move; my quiver does not take crowding.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，正好省我一步。
lines.en: You bumped into me and saved me a step.

lines.zh: 撞在肩甲上，你的指节响了吧。
lines.en: Hit my pauldron; did your knuckles crack?

lines.zh: 别碰弓，那是我吃饭的家伙。
lines.en: Do not touch the bow; it earns my meals.

lines.zh: 这点力气，推不动一个猎人。
lines.en: That little shove cannot move a hunter.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你退得比我快。
lines.en: We collided, and you gave ground faster.

lines.zh: 退三步，我等下要拉弓。
lines.en: Three paces back; I need room to draw.

lines.zh: 我站得稳，脚下是自家门槛。
lines.en: I stand firm; my feet are on my own threshold.

lines.zh: 撞坏了弩臂，你赔得起吗？
lines.en: Break my crossbow limb and can you pay for it?

lines.zh: 再挤，我就用回旋镖了。
lines.en: Push again and the boomerang comes out.

lines.zh: 林子里没有第二个我。
lines.en: There is no second one of me in this forest.

lines.zh: 我的木屋只放一把椅子。
lines.en: There is one chair in my cabin.

lines.zh: 同伴？突袭队解散很久了。
lines.en: Companions? The raiding party broke up long ago.

lines.zh: 这身披风我穿了很多年。
lines.en: I have worn this cloak for many years.

lines.zh: 先活过今晚，再谈别的。
lines.en: Survive tonight first, then we can talk.

lines.zh: 我不习惯有人睡在隔壁。
lines.en: I am not used to someone sleeping next door.

lines.zh: 弓和弩并排放着，已经够了。
lines.en: Bow and crossbow side by side are enough company.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Do not come so close; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 繁殖这些事，交给兔子吧。
lines.en: Leave breeding to the rabbits.

lines.zh: 我连自己的笑声都不喜欢。
lines.en: I do not even like my own laugh.

lines.zh: 这支箭还能用，捡起来。
lines.en: This arrow is still usable; I pick it up.

lines.zh: 回旋镖飞回来了，我伸手接住。
lines.en: The boomerang flies back and I catch it.

lines.zh: 地上有块碎铁，留着修弩。
lines.en: A scrap of iron on the ground, kept for the crossbow.

lines.zh: 我捡起猎物的毛，捏了捏。
lines.en: I pick up the prey's fur and pinch it.

lines.zh: 这枚铜钱不是林子里会有的。
lines.en: This copper coin does not belong in these woods.

lines.zh: 掉队的箭我一根根收进箭袋。
lines.en: I gather the stray arrows into my quiver one by one.

lines.zh: 有根绳头，正好修门。
lines.en: A bit of rope end, just right for the door.

lines.zh: 我把羽毛理直，插回去。
lines.en: I straighten the fletching and slot it back.

lines.zh: 这东西沾了血，擦干净再说。
lines.en: It has blood on it; I will wipe it first.

lines.zh: 捡完这处，我就回屋。
lines.en: Once this spot is picked clean, I go inside.

lines.zh: 你进了我的林子，这也算选择。
lines.en: You entered my forest; that counts as choosing.

lines.zh: 弓已经抬到一半了。
lines.en: My bow is already half raised.

lines.zh: 那只公猪我本来在追。
lines.en: I was chasing that boar before you came.

lines.zh: 先射腿，你跑不掉。
lines.en: The leg first, so you cannot run.

lines.zh: 你身上有值得抢的东西。
lines.en: You carry something worth taking.

lines.zh: 距离三十六步，正好。
lines.en: Thirty-six paces; that is perfect range.

lines.zh: 我看见你的手往腰后摸了。
lines.en: I saw your hand reach behind your hip.

lines.zh: 你别动，我正在瞄准。
lines.en: Do not move; I am taking aim.

lines.zh: 林间的风我这会儿不算了。
lines.en: I will not bother calculating the wind now.

lines.zh: 活捉也行，我只在乎结果。
lines.en: Taking you alive is also fine; I only care about results.

lines.zh: 我的弩先说话。
lines.en: My crossbow speaks first.

lines.zh: 别指望躲在树后面。
lines.en: Do not count on hiding behind a tree.

lines.zh: 这声弦响，是给你听的。
lines.en: This string's twang is meant for your ears.

lines.zh: 你被我放进今天的收获里了。
lines.en: I have added you to today's haul.

lines.zh: 那只鹿跑了，我改主意了。
lines.en: The deer got away, so I changed my mind.

lines.zh: 你往树后躲，我就换棵树。
lines.en: Hide behind a tree and I choose another one.

lines.zh: 我的眼角一直贴着你。
lines.en: The corner of my eye stays on you.

lines.zh: 数三下，我就放箭。
lines.en: Count three, and the arrow flies.

lines.zh: 我绕着走，把角度找好。
lines.en: I circle around to find the right angle.

lines.zh: 你听，箭羽在擦弦。
lines.en: Listen; the fletching is rubbing the string.

lines.zh: 你退的方向，我早就看过了。
lines.en: I have already checked where you are retreating.

lines.zh: 别想着绕后，我背后有门。
lines.en: Forget flanking me; my cabin door is behind.

lines.zh: 你喘得越来越重了。
lines.en: Your breathing grows heavier by the moment.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬手，是为了不惊你。
lines.en: I raise my hand slowly so as not to startle you.

lines.zh: 这个距离，风不影响箭。
lines.en: At this range the wind will not bend my arrow.

lines.zh: 你把盾放低了半寸。
lines.en: You lowered your shield half an inch.

lines.zh: 我等你自己走到那条线上。
lines.en: I wait for you to walk onto that line yourself.

lines.zh: 脚步声骗不了我。
lines.en: Footsteps do not lie to me.

lines.zh: 笑声憋在喉咙里，快出来了。
lines.en: The laugh is in my throat and about to escape.

lines.zh: 我把回旋镖在手里转。
lines.en: I spin the boomerang in my hand.

lines.zh: 你躲到木屋后面，我数到三。
lines.en: You hide behind the cabin. I count to three.

lines.zh: 我换了个高一点的位置。
lines.en: I move to a slightly higher spot.

lines.zh: 你听见笑声的时候已经晚了。
lines.en: When you hear the laughing, it is too late.

lines.zh: 我把你逼到墙角，笑出了声。
lines.en: I corner you against the wall and start laughing.

lines.zh: 这一击是为闯入者准备的。
lines.en: This blow is prepared for trespassers.

lines.zh: 弩臂砸在你肩上。
lines.en: The crossbow stock comes down on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你退无可退，正好。
lines.en: Nowhere left to retreat; perfect.

lines.zh: 我的笑声比刀还难受吧？
lines.en: My laugh cuts worse than the blade, does it not?

lines.zh: 回旋镖绕一圈，从背后回来。
lines.en: The boomerang circles once and returns from behind.

lines.zh: 别求饶，我听不懂。
lines.en: Save your pleading; I was never taught mercy.

lines.zh: 我踩住你的手。
lines.en: I pin your hand under my boot.

lines.zh: 这一下，够你记住这片林子。
lines.en: This one will teach you to remember these woods.

lines.zh: 你倒下的位置，我挑过了。
lines.en: I chose where you would fall.

lines.zh: 近身更好，我不必瞄准。
lines.en: Close range suits me; no aiming needed.

lines.zh: 你身上掉下来的东西归我。
lines.en: Whatever falls off you comes to me.

lines.zh: 我的笑声在树之间回响。
lines.en: My laugh bounces between the trees.

lines.zh: 再站起来，我就用弩。
lines.en: Stand up again and the crossbow comes out.

lines.zh: 回旋镖撞在墙上，又回来了。
lines.en: The boomerang hits the wall and comes back.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖压住你的胸口。
lines.en: My knee presses down on your chest.

lines.zh: 木屋的灯亮了，我推开窗。
lines.en: The cabin lamp is lit; I push the window open.

lines.zh: 我从门后走出来，弓已上弦。
lines.en: I step from behind the door, bow already strung.

lines.zh: 我把木屋的窗闩上，出门巡视。
lines.en: I bar the cabin window and step out to patrol.

lines.zh: 屋脊上的乌鸦先看见我。
lines.en: The crow on my roof saw me first.

lines.zh: 门轴响了一声，算作开场。
lines.en: The hinge creaks once as an opening.

lines.zh: 我把回旋镖从钉子上取下来。
lines.en: I take the boomerang down from its nail.

lines.zh: 松枝上的雪落了一地。
lines.en: Snow slides off the pines onto the ground.

lines.zh: 先看看有没有人踩过门槛。
lines.en: First I check whether anyone crossed my threshold.

lines.zh: 我在林间空地站定，等一个动静。
lines.en: I take my place in the clearing and wait for a sound.

lines.zh: 这身衣服有旧血的痕迹。
lines.en: There is old blood on these clothes.

lines.zh: 我把箭袋挂正，慢慢出了门。
lines.en: I settle my quiver and walk out slowly.

lines.zh: 夜里进林子的人，会遇见我。
lines.en: Those who enter at night will meet me.

lines.zh: 披风烧着了，我就地打滚。
lines.en: My cloak caught fire, so I roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 从树冠摔下来，弩差点脱手。
lines.en: Falling from the canopy nearly cost me my crossbow.

lines.zh: 林子里的水潭比看上去深。
lines.en: The forest pool is deeper than it looks.

lines.zh: 木屋的墙被炸塌了一角。
lines.en: The blast took down a corner of my cabin wall.

lines.zh: 你用我的箭射我，很有意思。
lines.en: You shoot me with my own arrow; amusing.

lines.zh: 这股味道让我手指发麻。
lines.en: This reek makes my fingers go numb.

lines.zh: 林子里连兔子都少了。
lines.en: Even the rabbits are scarce in these woods.

lines.zh: 雷劈在屋脊上，把我惊醒。
lines.en: Lightning struck my roof and woke me.

lines.zh: 脚下没有木头，这感觉很差。
lines.en: There is no wood underfoot, and I dislike it.
